questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content:
Match each of the diatomic molecules in Column I with its property/properties in Column II:

Column I Column II
(A) (P) Paramagnetic
(B) (Q) Undergoes oxidation
(C) (R) Undergoes reduction
(D) (S) Bond order 2
(T) Mixing of and orbitals
